heading: INT. DRAGON'S CAVERN - DENTAL CHAMBER - DAY

units.text: INT. DRAGON'S CAVERN - DENTAL CHAMBER - DAY
A vast cavern, hung with sacks of gold and a cracked mirror the size of a barn door.
In the center, a throne-sized stone chair, strapped with iron.
A huge reptilian jaw rests open on its headrest.
IGNATHRAX, a dragon the color of old copper, reclines with his lids half shut and a single enormous molar exposed.
Beside him, MAGISTER ODALRIC PYM, 60s, in a leather apron and a headlamp, holds a pair of tongs the length of a broom.
TAMSIN EKE, 20s, his apprentice, hovers at the foot of the chair with a bucket of cold well-water.
Don't clench.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: I am not clenching.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: You are clenching with your entire jaw. Release the jaw.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: It is difficult to release a thing one has been clenching since the Third Age.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: Master, the molar's cracked at the root.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: I can see that, Tamsin.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: It's the left one. The one he ate the knight with.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: That is a lie. I chewed that knight carefully.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: Be that as it may, the crown has to come out.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: Will it hurt?
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: Enormously.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: Then I will have a drink first.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: You may not have a drink. Your breath ignites.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: It is merely a mood.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: Master, he's sweating molten.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: Odalric looks down.
A slow rivulet of copper-colored sweat creeps along the stone floor, steaming.
Tamsin pours the bucket over it.
A hiss.
A cloud of steam.
Thank you, Tamsin.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: I did not ask for this. I merely wished to sleep on my gold.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: And you shall. After the tooth.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: Why must it be out?
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: Because the infection will spread to the brain, and the brain will then burn the cavern down.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: That is a fair argument.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: Open wide.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: Count to three.
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: One.
units.name: ODALRIC

units.text: He yanks.
The tongs come away with a molar the size of a milk churn.
Ignathrax roars; the cavern shakes; gold sacks tumble.
Tamsin dives under the chair.
Odalric holds the tooth aloft in triumph.
You said three!
units.name: IGNATHRAX

units.text: I lied.
units.name: ODALRIC
